name: com.degubites.herdkv
description: Unity-first embedded key-value store for save data and local game state. Pure C#, no native plugin.

samples.description: Open a local database, write a player name, and increment a launch counter.
Flush save data on application pause and quit.
Save and load a small inventory using typed HerdKV values.
Save and load chunk payloads by coordinate key.
Save local game settings with built-in codecs.
Open a database with schema migrations.
